contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #281: QAOA attains the SK optimum in the thermodynamic-first limit.
Audit and quantitative verification of the same Gaussian longitudinal seed reused through noncommuting gates in the staged September 25 2026 QAOA root calculus.

definitions.N: top child Fock number, with no weight inside a child mode

prop:tree-transfer and prop:energy identify fixed-word SK energy with Re<v,Lv>, not merely a Gaussian marginal.

thm:seed-simulation removes the same reused longitudinal Gaussian seed at every requested gate while preserving root-shift energy.
lem:seed-packet-estimates and lem:seed-high-directions: number-smooth packet bounds, separation and weak escape of the two initialized directions.
lem:seed-selective-accuracy gives ordinary o(r), normalized-special o(1), uniformly for moving number-smooth input families, using actual changing insertion directions.

lem:seed-one-echo gives (t/r)(v'_r-v_r)=-2tw_r+o(1) and transports the same w_r through compensated noncommuting mixers and repeated echoes.
lem:seed-gram-induction identifies the endogenous/external joint Grams and, by a separate one-particle calculation, the root-shift energy.
Formal visibility functions are nonzero analytic functions; one generic perturbation and successive probe selection supply all standard and huge-stage projection conditions.
Companion thm:full-support: every zero-temperature SK minimizer has full relative Stieltjes support [0,1), strict increase and q(t)=t, q'(t)=1.
Companion Corollary 7.1 and Proposition 7.2 supply the scalar value and shifted finite Gaussian coefficient identity used in QAOA section 3.
prop:gap-curvature: on an open constant interval gamma=c>0, q''' >= E[v^4]/(1000c^2)>0; for c=0, q' strictly increases.
tail:class, shape:backward, shape:forward and shape:ibp provide the backward/forward signs and integrated identities under their hypotheses.
cert:identity-lemma and cert:coercivity assert the exact polynomial identity and its integrated lower bound 1661507/1521000000 times E[v^4].
lem:regularity, lem:diffusion and lem:constant-transfer give compact-strip regularity, the gradient martingale and constant-interval differentiation.
lem:contact gives G>=0, G=0 on the support and q(s)=s, q'(s)<=1 at interior support points.
lem:no-terminal-plateau excludes a terminal support plateau, using ACZ2017 Remark 7.
Candidate quantitative verification: fixed visible seed-removal words admit ordinary weighted defect O(r^2), persistent seed displacement O(r), and root-shift energy O(r).
Exact root-shift energy for two reused Gaussian seed pulses separated by a noncommuting mixer differs from the fresh-seed circuit.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace SeedRemoval

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

theorem pullback_sub_norm (V : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a b : E) :
    ‖V.symm a - b‖ = ‖a - V b‖ := by
  calc
    ‖V.symm a - b‖ = ‖V (V.symm a - b)‖ := (V.norm_map _).symm
    _ = ‖a - V b‖ := by simp

theorem pullback_add_norm (V : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (a b : E) :
    ‖V.symm a + b‖ = ‖a + V b‖ := by
  calc
    ‖V.symm a + b‖ = ‖V (V.symm a + b)‖ := (V.norm_map _).symm
    _ = ‖a + V b‖ := by simp

theorem identity_defect (V Z : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
    ‖V.symm (Z (V x)) - Z x‖ ≤
      ‖V x - x‖ + ‖V (Z x) - Z x‖ := by
  rw [pullback_sub_norm]
  calc
    ‖Z (V x) - V (Z x)‖ =
        ‖(Z (V x) - Z x) + (Z x - V (Z x))‖ := by congr 1; abel
    _ ≤ ‖Z (V x) - Z x‖ + ‖Z x - V (Z x)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖V x - x‖ + ‖V (Z x) - Z x‖ := by
      rw [← map_sub, Z.norm_map, norm_sub_rev (Z x) (V (Z x))]

theorem flip_defect (V Z F : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (anti : ∀ x, Z (F x) = -(F (Z x))) (x : E) :
    ‖V.symm (Z (V x)) + Z x‖ ≤
      ‖V x - F x‖ + ‖V (Z x) - F (Z x)‖ := by
  rw [pullback_add_norm]
  calc
    ‖Z (V x) + V (Z x)‖ =
        ‖(Z (V x) - Z (F x)) + (V (Z x) - F (Z x))‖ := by
      rw [anti]
      congr 1
      abel
    _ ≤ ‖Z (V x) - Z (F x)‖ + ‖V (Z x) - F (Z x)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖V x - F x‖ + ‖V (Z x) - F (Z x)‖ := by
      rw [← map_sub, Z.norm_map]

theorem split_insertion_defect (V Z F : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (anti : ∀ x, Z (F x) = -(F (Z x))) (o s : E) :
    ‖V.symm (Z (V (o + s))) - Z (o + s) + (2 : ℝ) • Z s‖ ≤
      (‖V o - o‖ + ‖V (Z o) - Z o‖) +
      (‖V s - F s‖ + ‖V (Z s) - F (Z s)‖) := by
  have split :
      V.symm (Z (V (o + s))) - Z (o + s) + (2 : ℝ) • Z s =
      (V.symm (Z (V o)) - Z o) + (V.symm (Z (V s)) + Z s) := by
    simp only [map_add, two_smul]
    abel
  rw [split]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (identity_defect V Z o)
    (flip_defect V Z F anti s))

theorem transported_identity_defect (U V Z : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (s : E) :
    ‖U.symm (V.symm (Z (V s))) - U.symm (Z s)‖ ≤
      ‖V s - s‖ + ‖V (Z s) - Z s‖ := by
  calc
    ‖U.symm (V.symm (Z (V s))) - U.symm (Z s)‖ =
        ‖V.symm (Z (V s)) - Z s‖ := by rw [← map_sub, U.symm.norm_map]
    _ ≤ _ := identity_defect V Z s

theorem transported_flip_defect (U V Z F : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (anti : ∀ x, Z (F x) = -(F (Z x))) (s : E) :
    ‖U.symm (V.symm (Z (V s))) + U.symm (Z s)‖ ≤
      ‖V s - F s‖ + ‖V (Z s) - F (Z s)‖ := by
  calc
    ‖U.symm (V.symm (Z (V s))) + U.symm (Z s)‖ =
        ‖V.symm (Z (V s)) + Z s‖ := by rw [← map_add, U.symm.norm_map]
    _ ≤ _ := flip_defect V Z F anti s

theorem rescale_defect (r t K : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (d : E)
    (hd : ‖d‖ ≤ K * r ^ 2) :
    ‖(t / r) • d‖ ≤ |t| * K * r := by
  calc
    ‖(t / r) • d‖ = (|t| / r) * ‖d‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos hr]
    _ ≤ (|t| / r) * (K * r ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) hr.le)
    _ = |t| * K * r := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hr]; ring

theorem singular_echo_bound (r t K : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (v vp w : E)
    (hd : ‖vp - v + (2 * r) • w‖ ≤ K * r ^ 2) :
    ‖(t / r) • (vp - v) + (2 * t) • w‖ ≤ |t| * K * r := by
  have cancel : (t / r) * (2 * r) = 2 * t := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hr]
    <;> ring
  have algebra :
      (t / r) • (vp - v) + (2 * t) • w =
      (t / r) • (vp - v + (2 * r) • w) := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, cancel]
  rw [algebra]
  exact rescale_defect r t K hr _ hd

theorem finite_transport_accumulation {n : ℕ} (errors : Fin n → E)
    (bounds : Fin n → ℝ) (h : ∀ j, ‖errors j‖ ≤ bounds j) :
    ‖∑ j, errors j‖ ≤ ∑ j, bounds j :=
  (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => h j)

theorem reuse_energy_gap (q z : ℝ) :
    q * (1 + z ^ 2) / 4 - q * z / 2 = q * (1 - z) ^ 2 / 4 := by
  ring

theorem gaussian_gap_positive :
    0 < Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * (1 - Real.exp (-1)) ^ 2 / 4 := by
  have h : Real.exp (-1) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hp : 0 < 1 - Real.exp (-1) := by linarith
  positivity

end SeedRemoval

claims.natural_statement: For every fixed b>0, finite formally visible seeded target word and fixed finite exact zero-clock ensemble-control lists, there exist C,r0>0 such that the actual ordinary compiler, for 0<r<r0, has ordinary H<-Dom(1+N) operator defect at most Cr^2, normalized-special packet defect at most Cr on the first-number graph unit ball, and transported insertion u_r^*Z psi_S/r within Cr of the same initial w_r through every finite sequence of compensated noncommuting mixers and echoes. Each actual echo displacement differs from -2t w_r by at most Cr, and its root-shift energy differs from the formal reused-seed energy by at most Cr. Inputs with graph norm O(r^-a), 0<=a<1, retain ordinary o(r) and normalized-special o(1) errors.

For any finite local word U of X mixers and longitudinal seed gates with symmetric joint seed law, followed by one actual cost gamma and mixer eta, the root-shift energy is gamma exp(-2 gamma^2) sin(4 eta) E<X>_U. For two seed angles a=c=1/2 separated by mixer beta=pi/4 and read at gamma=1/2, eta=pi/8, reusing one standard Gaussian instead of taking independent Gaussians raises that energy by exp(-1/2)(1-exp(-1))^2/4>0.
